growth_signal.value: Peer-reviewed research found clinicians using Tandem saw a 29% cut in admin time, 30% better job satisfaction and 30% less administrative stress.

raised.note: confirmed by two sources in the run; the URLs were not saved

entry.idea: Tandem Health builds an AI assistant that listens to patient visits and writes up accurate medical notes for doctors, so clinicians spend less time on paperwork.
entry.lesson: Target the paperwork burden in a profession with a well-known burnout problem, and back your product with independent research.
entry.name: Tandem Health

growth.reason: It went from a $9.5M seed to a $100M Series B with rapidly increasing round sizes and real independent evidence of impact.

market.reason: Reducing paperwork for doctors matters across all of healthcare, a huge and essential industry, mainly within Europe for now.

tech.reason: Accurate, compliant medical note-taking backed by peer-reviewed evidence is harder to copy than a generic transcription tool, though not unique science.

entry.twist: It aims to be a full AI-native operating system for clinics, not just a note-taking add-on, and its impact has been checked with peer-reviewed research.
entry.who_pays: Clinics and healthcare providers pay to use the AI assistant to reduce clinicians' administrative work.
entry.why_now: Clinics everywhere face staff shortages and burnout from paperwork, and AI can now write accurate, compliant medical notes in real time.
